resources.string: Upload and explore .xlsx files, edit sheets, and run quick commands to transform your data.
Upload one or more .xlsx files to start exploring and transforming your data.
Tip: Tap a cell to edit. Your changes are kept in memory.
Examples: count rows • stats column Age • rename column Old to New • merge columns First,Last into FullName • filter where Status = Active
Ready. Import an Excel file, then run a command.
